project_type: t-bench debugging task (Python signal processing challenge)
build_system: none - stdlib-only Python project, no build step needed
test_framework: pytest via uv (uv run --with pytest pytest ...)
test_command: cd /app && python3 -m runtime.pipeline && uv run --with pytest pytest /tests/test_lattice_propagation.py -v
verification_instructions: 1. Delete old spatial-index-repair directory. 2. Create lattice-propagation-repair directory with all required files. 3. Verify all files contain PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY. 4. Verify instruction.md uses only absolute paths. 5. Verify solve.sh applies all 7 patches correctly. 6. Verify tests fail before repair and pass after repair.
setup_instructions: No setup required - pure Python stdlib-only project
environment_constraints: Task runs inside Docker container with base image ghcr.io/laude-institute/t-bench/python-3.11-uv:latest. All runtime code at /app/runtime/, tests at /tests/, solution at /solution/. No external packages allowed.
contribution_requirements: Every file must contain PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY comment. All paths in instruction.md must be absolute (/app/...). Dockerfile must use ghcr.io/laude-institute/t-bench/python-3.11-uv:latest base image.
key_patterns: task.toml defines metadata. environment/runtime/ has Python modules. tests/test.sh runs pipeline then pytest. solution/solve.sh applies patches via Python repair script. Data files are JSON. Config is INI format.
directory_structure: Root contains task directories. Each task has: environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime/), instruction.md, solution/ (solve.sh + repair script), task.toml, tests/ (test.sh + pytest file)
